full_judgment: 8. Post of Research Officers, Statistical Officers and such other posts of this nature, where the prescribed qualification is 1st Class or High 2nd Class Master's decree should be placed in Grade No. V and where prescribed qualification is less than this are to be placed in appropriate lower national grades on the basis of pay limits indicated by the Administrative and Service Reorganization Committee.
